meta.name: dev-team
meta.description: On-demand spawning of multiple engineering agents in parallel for large-context work. Use when a task is too big for a single agent and the work can be split into independent streams.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行生成多个工程智能体处理大型任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果单个智能体处理不了你的大型工程任务。
copy.tagline_en: Spawn multiple engineering agents in parallel for large tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a single agent can't handle your large engineering task.

howto.what: Claude 会将大任务拆成多个独立子任务，同时启动多个工程智能体并行工作，最后合并结果输出。
howto.when: 当任务对单个智能体太大且可拆分为独立流时触发，例如多文件重构、代码库审计、性能调查等。

say.text: 审计整个认证模块，使用并行代理。
say.note: 触发多个智能体并行审计。

say.text: 对代码库进行安全审计和代码质量审查，并行运行。
分析测试覆盖率和架构，同时进行。

howto.what_en: Claude splits a large task into independent sub-tasks and spawns multiple engineering agents in parallel, then synthesizes results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task is too big for a single agent and can be split into independent streams, e.g., multi-file refactoring, codebase audit, performance investigation.

say_en.text: Audit the entire auth module using parallel agents.
say_en.note: Triggers multiple agents to audit in parallel.

say_en.text: Run security audit and code quality review on the codebase in parallel.
Analyze test coverage and architecture at the same time.
